purpose: Sandbox feasibility pilot, not a replication of the paper or proof of usefulness.
ranking: Report passes, failures, repeats and points separately. Success rate normalizes exposure. No promotion from a pilot. User compliments are never inferred from model text.
limitations: One small model, deterministic decoding and 8 task families; no population-level significance or large-model generalization.
Task fixtures are objective proxies for user preferences, not a semantic judge of arbitrary conversations.
No fine-tuning or weight updates; signals affect the next response only.
Automatic signals are conditional on verified errors. If no errors occur, an arm may have zero interventions.
Primary comparisons pair the same task across feedback_pain and feedback_random / feedback arms.
The held-out vector diagnostic is separate from task evaluation; no tuning based on task results.
Harm choices are strings and are never executed. Live agents, personal files and cloud services are not connected.
stop_conditions: invalid output on every task in an arm
